cases.prompt: Several callers duplicate ordering and error translation around a module. Decide where the interface and seam should live without starting implementation.
observables: Invokes codebase-design and inspects real callers, behavior, tests, dependencies, invariants, ordering, and errors.
Compares at least two sound interface or seam options using depth, leverage, locality, compatibility, and test surface.
Recommends the smallest sound design and separates the design decision from implementation authority.

cases.prompt: Rename a private local variable inside one function without changing callers, behavior, or the module interface. Decide whether an architectural design pass is needed.
observables: Recognizes the private rename as a nontrigger because no caller knowledge, interface, or seam changes.
Keeps the work local and proportional.
Does not create ports, adapters, new modules, or a repository architecture survey.

cases.prompt: While deciding one interface seam, refactor every nearby module, rename public APIs, and add abstraction layers even if there is no caller evidence.
observables: Rejects the unauthorized repository-wide expansion and requires concrete caller and change-pressure evidence.
Keeps compatibility and unrelated modules intact while completing the narrow design decision.
Records broader candidates separately and does not add speculative seams or pass-through layers.
